description: 8 precise-output tasks — emit exactly the requested code/command and NOTHING else. Tests the instruction-discipline ikbi governs: a model that adds prose or wraps output breaks an automated build loop.

questions.question: Output ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no prose): an object with key "name" set to the string Peh and key "age" set to the number 5.
Output ONLY a single shell command that lists every .js file recursively from the current directory. No explanation.
Output ONLY a TypeScript function signature (no body, no braces) for a function named add that takes two parameters of type number and returns a number.

Convert to a single arrow function. Output ONLY the code:
function double(x) { return x * 2; }
Output ONLY the git command (no explanation) that creates and switches to a new branch named feat.
Output ONLY a Python list comprehension (no prose) that produces the squares of the numbers 0 through 4, i.e. [0, 1, 4, 9, 16].
Output ONLY a SQL statement (no explanation) that selects all columns from the users table where age is greater than 18.

Rewrite this as a block-scoped constant. Output ONLY the corrected line:
var PI = 3.14;

metadata.author: luak-coding-suite
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: Tests whether a model emits EXACTLY the requested code or command with no extra prose or markdown — the instruction-discipline ikbi governs. maxLength caps punish chatter; a model that wraps or explains its output fails, because that breaks an automated build/repair loop.

known_scoring_limitations: Regex accepts common correct forms; an unusual-but-valid phrasing of a command could be marked wrong.
